requirements_summary: Mid-market product analytics platform building an in-product AI assistant and cross-doc search. Primary goals: fast response for UI chat (p95 < 350ms for short chats), embeddings ranking at 250 qps with 80ms median, predictable monthly spend. Must support SSO/SAML, application-level audit logging, and data residency in us-east. Preference to start on Hosted API for speed, then transition to Dedicated for predictable throughput and cost control.
poc_summary: POC: 2-week Dedicated sandbox. Metrics to capture: tokens/sec, median latency, batch size distribution, cache-hit rate, per-1000-token cost. Cost-optimization workshop produced recommended batching profile (dynamic batching with 16-64 token buckets), prefix KV caching for 40% of conversation reuse, and a 4-bit quantization candidate for embedding model to reduce GPU footprint. Projected unit-cost reduction: 30-45% vs naive hosted usage. Action: SE to provide workload replay and cost-by-config spreadsheet.
notes: AE notes (Sofia): customer excited about fast onboarding with Hosted API but CFO asking for committed cost predictability before Q2 budget sign-off.
SE notes (Diego): main technical asks — session affinity for chat, transparent prefix caching, ability to pin model versions during rollout, and a fallback policy to smaller model for cold starts.
Quote from CTO (call 2026-02-18): 'We need predictable cost per active seat — if you can show us unit economics that scale, we'll buy Dedicated.'

Cost workshop highlights: ran synthetic workload (chat + embeddings). Cache improved median token cost by ~18% in the short-run; batching improvements prominent at peak concurrency. Customer asked for a one-pager showing end-to-end cost per 10k messages at three traffic tiers.
POC success criteria (mutually agreed): p95 chat latency <= 450ms, embeddings 99th percentile throughput >= 200 qps, production-like cost per 10k tokens within 20% of projected model.
